2.2.1.1. Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config.__init__¶

Config.__init__(hll_dir, out_dir, gss_par_mappings, gss_int_mappings, strict_mode=True)¶

Configuration for api.generate_certification_lcf()

Parameters:

  • hll_dir (string) – Directory containing the HLL input files to be provided to Prover Certifier, notably DeclarationsINT.hll and DeclarationsPAR.hll. These files are normally generated by the Certification_HLL_Dump package.

  • out_dir (string) – Directory to place output files in. The directory will be created unless it already exists. The LCF tables will be placed in a subdirectory named ‘lcf-tables’.

  • req_class_names ([string]) – List of names of GSS classes containing requirements.

  • strict_mode (bool) – Strict mode, delete generated files on errors.
